info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Lifecycle Management API
info.description: The Party Lifecycle Management API provides a comprehensive solution for managing the lifecycle of parties involved in banking transactions. This API allows users to retrieve information about various entities, such as customers, partners, and other stakeholders, essential for sales and banking operations. Typical consumers include banking institutions and sales teams looking to enhance their understanding of party relationships and histories. The endpoint facilitates seamless integration with existing systems, enabling efficient data retrieval to improve decision-making processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the lifecycle management details of sales parties.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to access comprehensive information regarding the lifecycle of parties involved in sales, including their status, history, and any relevant data associated with them. Ideal for monitoring and management processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve lifecycle management information for sales parties. The provided parameters will define the criteria for filtering and retrieving the relevant data. Ensure that the request adheres to the specified schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of party lifecycle management data.
